_readme: Patient-journey stages in order. 'applies' per case type: yes | partly | no. 'notes' explain what the stage means for each case type. A stage gets lessons when src/content/modules/<stage-id>.json exists and is registered in src/content/index.js.

caseTypes.label: External order
caseTypes.blurb: Lab, radiology or pathology orders from external doctors or hospitals, often without a full patient visit. The invoice may go to the ordering institution.

caseTypes.label: Outpatient
caseTypes.blurb: Visits and day procedures without an overnight stay: TARDOC or ambulatory flat rates, tiers garant / tiers payant, AVOS.

caseTypes.label: Inpatient
caseTypes.blurb: Stays with at least one night: SwissDRG, TARPSY, ST Reha, coding, case merging, supplementary insurance.

stages.title: Referral
stages.summary: Someone sends the patient or the sample. The referral starts the case and decides how clean the data will be later.

notes.external: The order form is the referral: ordering doctor or institution, patient data, requested analysis.
notes.outpatient: A GP or specialist refers for a consultation or day procedure; managed-care models need the referral for payment.
notes.inpatient: Elective referral, emergency or transfer; hospital choice and payer are clarified early.

stages.title: Scheduling & pre-admission
stages.summary: Slots, sample logistics, beds and the pre-admission checklist. The cheapest place to prevent billing errors.

notes.external: Sample logistics for lab and pathology, slots for external imaging, complete order data before the service.
notes.outpatient: Slots, reminders, wait lists – and the flat-rate or TARDOC question before the visit.
notes.inpatient: OR slot, bed and pre-admission checklist; AVOS check and the 18-day readmission rule.

stages.title: Cost approval & insurance check
stages.summary: Who pays: KVG, UVG, IV, VVG, canton. Cost approvals, supplementary coverage and the AVOS check by insurers.

notes.external: Rare: some analyses, such as certain genetic tests, need prior approval by the insurer.
notes.outpatient: Special therapies, devices and outpatient VVG services; tiers payant agreements.
notes.inpatient: Cost approval from insurer and canton, VVG coverage for semi-private and private wards, out-of-canton differences.

stages.title: Admission & registration
stages.summary: Master data, case creation, case type and insurance assignment. Errors here cause most rejections later.

notes.external: Case for the order: patient match and invoice recipient (insurer, patient or ordering institution).
notes.outpatient: Outpatient case per visit or series; insurance relationship and referrer.
notes.inpatient: Admission with case type, insurance assignment, ward and first movement.

stages.title: Treatment & documentation
stages.summary: Orders, movements, transfers and service entry – the raw material for coding and billing.

notes.external: Analysis or exam performed; result back to the ordering doctor; services captured from the lab or RIS.
notes.outpatient: Consultation and procedures documented; services captured for TARDOC or a flat rate.
notes.inpatient: Orders, transfers between wards, service entry, documentation for coding.

stages.title: Coding & grouping
stages.summary: ICD-10-GM and CHOP, SwissDRG grouping, flat-rate triggers. Coding quality is revenue quality.

notes.external: No grouping: services are tariff positions (Analysenliste, TARDOC).
notes.outpatient: Flat-rate triggers and service capture: TARDOC vs ambulatory flat rates.
notes.inpatient: ICD-10-GM and CHOP coding, SwissDRG / TARPSY / ST Reha grouping, case merging.

ish: Diagnoses and procedures on the case

stages.title: Discharge
stages.summary: Discharge letter, follow-up care, data back to the referring doctor, case closure.

notes.external: Not applicable: the result report replaces a discharge.
notes.outpatient: End of visit or series: report to the referrer, follow-up booking.
notes.inpatient: Discharge letter, follow-up care, data to the referrer, case closure for coding.

stages.title: Billing
stages.summary: XML invoice standards, tariff validation, OKP vs VVG invoices, physician fees.

notes.external: Invoice to the insurer, the patient or the ordering institution; Analysenliste and outpatient tariffs.
notes.outpatient: TARDOC or flat-rate invoice, XML standard, tiers garant or tiers payant, copy to the patient.
notes.inpatient: DRG invoice to insurer and canton; separate OKP and VVG invoices; physician fees in supplementary insurance.

stages.title: Rejections & receivables
stages.summary: Every rejection has a root cause upstream. Rejection handling, dunning, SAP FI/CO. Target: at most 3 % rejected.

notes.external: Wrong insurer or recipient; small amounts with high rework cost.
notes.outpatient: Tariff validation errors, missing referrals, wrong insurer; reminders and dunning.
notes.inpatient: Insurer queries, AVOS checks, coding audits, open differences; SAP FI/CO.

stages.title: Analytics & controlling
stages.summary: KPIs, revenue completeness and data quality along the whole order-to-cash process.

notes.external: Order completeness, unmatched orders, turnaround times.
notes.outpatient: No-show rate, flat-rate share, rejection rate by reason.
notes.inpatient: Case mix, coding quality, merged cases, open differences.
